results: 1. medication review: long-term risperidone with concomitant sertraline; myoclonus resolved completely within 24 h of withdrawing RISPERIDONE alone
2. serotonin syndrome criteria (Hunter): NOT met - no clonus, hyperreflexia, fever or autonomic instability
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Risperidone-induced myoclonus (extrapyramidal adverse drug reaction, with the prominent abdominal distension representing risperidone-associated weight gain / metabolic syndrome)
1. Sertraline-induced myoclonus
2. Mild or atypical serotonin syndrome (despite negative Hunter criteria)
3. Antipsychotic-related movement disorder of unclear mechanism
